verses.arabicText: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.englishText: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].[1577]
verses.footnotes: [1577] This was a sign given by Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) when the Quraysh challenged him to show them a miracle.

verses.arabicText: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
verses.englishText: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."[1578]

verses.arabicText: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.englishText: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verses.englishText: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.

verses.arabicText: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.englishText: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

verses.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
verses.englishText: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller[1579] calls to something forbidding,
verses.footnotes: [1579] Said to be an angel announcing the account and judgement.

verses.arabicText: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
verses.englishText: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

verses.arabicText: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
verses.englishText: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

verses.arabicText: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verses.englishText: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

verses.arabicText: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verses.englishText: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

verses.arabicText: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
verses.englishText: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

verses.arabicText: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verses.englishText: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

verses.arabicText: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
verses.englishText: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

verses.arabicText: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.englishText: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.englishText: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.englishText: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.[1580]
verses.footnotes: [1580] To those after them, who were expected to derive a lesson from previous occurrences.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.englishText: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.englishText: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
verses.englishText: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

verses.arabicText: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
verses.englishText: Extracting the people[1581] as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

verses.arabicText: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.englishText: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.englishText: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.englishText: Thamūd denied the warning.

verses.arabicText: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.englishText: And said, "Is it one human being[1582] among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

verses.arabicText: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
verses.englishText: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

verses.arabicText: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verses.englishText: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verses.englishText: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.[1583]
verses.footnotes: [1583] This and the following verse are an address to Ṣāliḥ (upon him be peace).

verses.arabicText: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
verses.englishText: And inform them that the water is shared between them,[1584] each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
verses.footnotes: [1584] i.e., between the tribe of Thamūd and the she-camel - a day for each to drink.

verses.arabicText: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.englishText: But they called their companion,[1585] and he dared[1586] and hamstrung [her].
verses.footnotes:
[1585] i.e., the worst and most despicable among them.
[1586] Or "he took," referring to his sword or to the she-camel.

verses.arabicText: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.englishText: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.englishText: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.englishText: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.englishText: The people of Lot denied the warning.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
verses.englishText: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.

verses.arabicText: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verses.englishText: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.englishText: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.englishText: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.englishText: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

verses.arabicText: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.englishText: So taste My punishment and warning.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.englishText: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.englishText: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.englishText: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

verses.arabicText: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.englishText: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
verses.englishText: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

verses.arabicText: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.englishText: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].[1587]
verses.footnotes: [1587] This foretold event took place on the day of Badr.

verses.arabicText: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.englishText: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.englishText: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.[1588].

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.englishText: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."[1589]
verses.footnotes: [1589] One of the proper names of Hell.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
verses.englishText: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verses.englishText: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.englishText: And We have already destroyed your kinds,[1590] so is there any who will remember?
verses.footnotes: [1590] i.e., those similar to you in attitude and behavior when they rejected Allāh's messengers.

verses.arabicText: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.englishText: And everything they did is in written records.

verses.arabicText: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.englishText: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
verses.englishText: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

verses.arabicText: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verses.englishText: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.[1591]
verses.footnotes: [1591] Who accomplishes whatever He wills whenever He wills.
